prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore, which brings a deleted episode back with its cuts at its old number and moves later episodes down one; non-members get a 404. The message shown after a delete on the Episodes page now has an Undo button, in English and Korean. All 18 backend tests pass (6 new), tsc is clean, and lint shows no new problems in the changed files. Restoring an episode that isn't deleted changes nothing and returns it, so a double Undo is harmless. If the list has shrunk since the delete, the episode goes at the end.

+def _renumber_episodes(session: Session, project_id: UUID, insert: Optional[Episode] = None, position: Optional[int] = None) -> List[Episode]:
+    """
+    Number a project's live episodes 1, 2, 3... with no gaps or repeats,
+    keeping their current relative order. If `insert` is given, it is placed
+    at `position` (1-based, clamped) and the episodes from there move down.
+    Returns the episodes in order. Does not commit.
+    """
+    episodes = session.exec(
+        select(Episode).where(Episode.project_id == project_id).where(Episode.deleted_at == None)
+    ).all()
+    episodes = sorted(
+        (ep for ep in episodes if insert is None or ep.id != insert.id),
+        key=lambda ep: (ep.episode_order, ep.created_at, str(ep.id)),
+    )
+    if insert is not None:
+        index = len(episodes) if position is None else min(max(position - 1, 0), len(episodes))
+        episodes.insert(index, insert)
+    for number, ep in enumerate(episodes, start=1):
+        if ep.episode_order != number:
+            ep.episode_order = number
+            session.add(ep)
+    return episodes
+
+
+def _episode_out(session: Session, episode: Episode) -> dict:
+    """Build an EpisodeOut payload, including the first cut's image URL."""
+    first_cut = session.exec(
+        select(StoryCut)
+        .where(StoryCut.episode_id == episode.id)
+        .where(StoryCut.image_path != None)
+        .order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)
+        .limit(1)
+    ).first()
+    first_cut_image_url = None
+    if first_cut:
+        path = first_cut.image_path
+        if path.startswith("http://") or path.startswith("https://") or not settings.STORAGE_HOST:
+            first_cut_image_url = path
+        else:
+            first_cut_image_url = f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{path}"
+    return {
+        "id": episode.id,
+        "title": episode.title,
+        "episode_order": episode.episode_order,
+        "project_id": episode.project_id,
+        "story_summary": episode.story_summary or "",
+        "status": episode.status,
+        "created_at": episode.created_at,
+        "background_info": episode.background_info,
+        "character_outfits": episode.character_outfits,
+        "first_cut_image": first_cut_image_url,
+    }

+def restore_episode(
+    *,
+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    episode_id: UUID,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Restore a deleted episode (with its cuts) at the place it had; the
+    episodes from there on move down one place. Restoring an episode that
+    is not deleted changes nothing.
+    """
+    episode = session.get(Episode, episode_id)
+    if not episode:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+    project = session.get(Project, episode.project_id)
+    if not project or project.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+    try:
+        user_uuid = UUID(str(current_user_id))
+    except ValueError:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+    if not session.get(WorkspaceMember, (project.workspace_id, user_uuid)):
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    if episode.deleted_at is not None:
+        # A deleted episode keeps the number it had when it was deleted
+        position = episode.episode_order
+        episode.deleted_at = None
+        session.add(episode)
+        _renumber_episodes(session, project.id, insert=episode, position=position)
+        session.commit()
+    session.refresh(episode)
+    return _episode_out(session, episode)
+

+def duplicate_episode(
+    *,
+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    episode_id: UUID,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Duplicate an episode with all its cuts. The copy is placed right after
+    the original and later episodes move down one place. Free of charge.
+    """
+    episode = session.get(Episode, episode_id)
+    if not episode or episode.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+    project = session.get(Project, episode.project_id)
+    if not project or project.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+    try:
+        user_uuid = UUID(str(current_user_id))
+    except ValueError:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+    if not session.get(WorkspaceMember, (project.workspace_id, user_uuid)):
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    new_episode = Episode(
+        project_id=project.id,
+        title=f"{episode.title} (Copy)",
+        story_summary=episode.story_summary,
+        episode_order=0,  # set by _renumber_episodes below
+        status="ready" if episode.status == "generating" else episode.status,
+        background_info=episode.background_info,
+        character_outfits=copy.deepcopy(episode.character_outfits),
+        character_reference_board_urls=copy.deepcopy(episode.character_reference_board_urls or []),
+    )
+    # Place the copy right after its original; later episodes move down one
+    ordered = _renumber_episodes(session, project.id)
+    original_position = next(i for i, ep in enumerate(ordered, start=1) if ep.id == episode.id)
+    session.add(new_episode)
+    _renumber_episodes(session, project.id, insert=new_episode, position=original_position + 1)
+    session.flush()
+
+    cuts = session.exec(
+        select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == episode.id).order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)
+    ).all()
+    for cut in cuts:
+        session.add(StoryCut(
+            episode_id=new_episode.id,
+            cut_order=cut.cut_order,
+            script=cut.script,
+            location=cut.location,
+            time_of_day=cut.time_of_day,
+            transition_ref=cut.transition_ref,
+            selected_layout=cut.selected_layout,
+            aspect_ratio=cut.aspect_ratio,
+            image_path=cut.image_path,
+            image_asset_id=cut.image_asset_id,
+            status="idle" if cut.status == "generating" else cut.status,
+            dialogues=copy.deepcopy(cut.dialogues or []),
+            appearing_characters=copy.deepcopy(cut.appearing_characters or []),
+            embedding=copy.deepcopy(cut.embedding),
+            refer_prev_cut=cut.refer_prev_cut,
+        ))
+
+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(new_episode)
+
+    return _episode_out(session, new_episode)
